title: Japanese-Style Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe inspired by Japanese cuisine. This dish features a nutty flavor profile and can be customized with your favorite vegetables.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the nutty stir noodles and cook according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the creamy sauce and 1 tablespoon of water. Pour the sauce over the noodles and stir to combine.
Add the frozen broccoli to the skillet and stir to combine with the noodles and sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the broccoli is tender.
Stir in the corn kernels and cook for an additional minute.
